balanceLabel.description: Small caption above the large balance amount on the dashboard.

gifted.description: Word in the top-up bonus badge, e.g. '+3% Gifted'.

customTopup.description: Label for the custom top-up amount button.

customAmountLabel.message: Custom top-up amount in US dollars
customAmountLabel.description: Accessibility label for the custom top-up input field.

increase.description: Accessibility label for the up-arrow that increases the custom amount.

decrease.description: Accessibility label for the down-arrow that decreases the custom amount.

topUpBalance.description: Green button that starts a Stripe checkout to add funds.

processing.description: Shown on the Top Up button while the checkout session is being created.

checkoutError.message: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
checkoutError.description: Generic error shown when starting a top-up checkout fails.

termsOfService.description: Link text for the terms of service in the top-up disclaimer.

privacyPolicy.description: Link text for the privacy policy in the top-up disclaimer.

disclaimerAgree.message: By topping up, you agree to our %TOS% and %PRIVACY%.
disclaimerAgree.description: Top-up disclaimer. Keep the %TOS% and %PRIVACY% markers exactly — they are replaced with the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links.

disclaimerFx.message: Foreign exchange fees may apply if you pay in a currency other than USD.
disclaimerFx.description: Top-up disclaimer about currency conversion costs.

disclaimerJurisdiction.message: Within the United States, only residents of Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Massachusetts, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, New Hampshire, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, Wisconsin, and Wyoming can use DisinfaX and top up their balance; Washington, D.C., all U.S. territories, and any states not listed are excluded. Outside the United States, it is available in Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, Japan, Taiwan, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Malaysia, Vietnam, and Switzerland.

signOut.description: Button to sign the user out of the extension.

onboardDisinfactClick.message: Clicking %BTN% reveals claims and will charge your balance
onboardDisinfactClick.description: Onboarding popover next to the Disinfact button (pointer devices). %BTN% is replaced with the button's name.

onboardDisinfactTap.message: Tapping %BTN% reveals claims and will charge your balance
onboardDisinfactTap.description: Onboarding popover next to the Disinfact button (touch devices). %BTN% is replaced with the button's name.

onboardWillCharge.description: Onboarding popover for the Fact-Check All and tweet-level Translate buttons. %BTN% is replaced with the button's name.

onboardFactcheck.description: Onboarding popover for a claim's Fact-Check button. %BTN% is replaced with the button's name.

onboardTranslations.description: Onboarding popover for the translation button inside the popover. %BTN% is replaced with the button's icon.

onboardRefreshes.description: Onboarding popover for the refresh button inside the popover. %BTN% is replaced with the button's icon.

appDescription.message: Detects and highlights misinformation in tweets using AI analysis.

verdictTrue.description: Standalone verdict label: the claim is true.

verdictFalse.description: Standalone verdict label: the claim is false.

verdictUnknown.description: Verdict label when the claim cannot be determined.

verdictResearching.description: Verdict label shown while the claim is being analyzed.

researchingWords.description: Pipe-separated list of playful words shown at random (one per claim) on the claim-highlight badge while that claim is being fact-checked, instead of a static 'Fact-Checking' label.

adjMostly.description: Veracity adjective: mostly true/false with some nuance.

adjArguably.description: Veracity adjective: arguably true/false, leaning one way.

adjPartially.description: Veracity adjective: partially true/false, mixed evidence.

adjEquivocally.description: Veracity adjective: equivocally true/false, balanced evidence.

badgeVerdictOnly.description: Badge pattern with only the verdict word. $VERDICT$$ = True/False.

badgeVerdictAdj.description: Badge pattern: verdict + adj in parens. $VERDICT$$, $ADJ$$.

badgeAdjVerdictAdj2.description: Badge: confidence adj, veracity adj, verdict. $ADJ2$$, $ADJ$$, $VERDICT$$.

refreshBatchTooltip.description: Tooltip for the button that re-classifies every claim in this tweet.

refreshClaimTooltip.description: Tooltip for the individual claim re-research button.

researchingText.description: Text shown next to the spinner while waiting for analysis results.

translateFactChecks.description: Button shown at top of tweet when fact-check highlights need translation to the browser language.

translateClaimButton.description: Button in popover to translate a specific claim text or reasoning to the browser language.

factCheckedFloatingButton.description: Floating button shown at the top of the timeline when an on-hold tweet finishes classification off-screen. Clicking scrolls back to the tweet.

goBackFloatingButton.description: Floating button shown at the bottom of the timeline after scrolling back to a classified tweet. Clicking returns the user to their original scroll position.

disinfactButton.description: Button that identifies the claims in a tweet and looks up their verdicts in the database.

badgeFiller.description: Filler word between confidence adjective and veracity adjective in the combined badge pattern.

badgeAdjVerdictAdj2Verbose.description: Badge: verbose confidence adj, filler, veracity adj, verdict for multi-word adjectives.

landingTagline1.message: Reveal the Truth. Find the Lies.

factCheckAllButton.description: Button that fact-checks every claim in the tweet at once (batch action, distinct from the singular per-claim Fact-Check button).
